title: Collecting the Borderland Science Research Association archive

tellings.quote:
I went to Eureka, California.
>> I met with this guy in his garage
>> and we packed it all together and sent
it back to Sweden.

plain: The archive of the Borderland Science Research Association, an old California group that studied fringe science and UFOs, sat in a man's garage in Eureka, California, until it was boxed up and shipped to Sweden. The Swedish UFO researcher Clas Svahn, who collects UFO records, says he did it himself: "I met with this guy in his garage and we packed it all together and sent it back to Sweden." He tells it as part of how he saved a large store of early UFO material.
